name: Ankhural
description: Ankhural was a planet in the system of the same name in Hutt Space. It had one city which was protected by a ray shield to hold off giant clouds of dust from the silicon fields. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry took refuge at abandoned podracing track for repairs on its headquarters, the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike.
